note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 2026-11-23. Research was severely constrained: the web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' for every query, and direct fetches of company-data aggregators (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck) returned HTTP 403; Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo HTML endpoints returned irrelevant or empty results. Consequently NO verified finding could be established on any of the five risk dimensions, and all fields are set to null rather than guessed. (1) Sanctions: the OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable but is a JavaScript form whose results cannot be retrieved by a plain GET; no name query could be executed. No UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List screening was possible. Absence of a hit is therefore NOT confirmed - sanctions_hit = null means 'not screened', not 'clear'. (2) Indian courts: Indian Kanoon (indiankanoon.org) was queried for 'Spraytech Systems' and returned exactly 1 document - 'B S Dugar vs Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL)', 5 March 2026, a Central Information Commission/RTI matter in which 'SPRAYTECH' appears only as one name in a list of vendors that supplied materials to IOCL against tenders. That is an incidental third-party mention, not a proceeding involving the company; no litigation by or against Spraytech Systems (India) Pvt Ltd was found. NCLT, High Court and district court dockets were not searched. (3) Regulator actions / negative news: nothing found, but search coverage was effectively zero, so this is an unverified blank, not a clean record. (4) Credit rating: no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action located; rating = null, not public in anything retrieved. (5) Russia/CIS supply evidence: nothing found; no customs, B-L or trade-data source could be reached, so rf_supply = null (no evidence either way). Per project rules, none of the above is a rejection ground; the company is retained. Recommended follow-up before any decision: manual OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS screening by exact legal name and by the claimed PAN AAKCS8770L (PAN itself unverified - not researched per role scope), a paid registry pull (MCA master data, ZaubaCorp/TheCompanyCheck) for charges, directors and status, an NCLT/e-courts name search, and a trade-data check (Volza/Export Genius/ImportYeti) for Russia/CIS consignee records. Note also that the declared industry ('metallurgy and mining') and the declared HS codes (8424.90 sprayer parts, 8481.90 valve parts, 9013.10 telescopic sights) look like a spraying-equipment/valve manufacturer rather than a mining company - flagged for the identity/HS team, not a risk finding.
